verdict: IMPROVED VISUAL PROPOSAL, NOT INSTALLATION READY. Shared bedside plates, service entries, adjacent dry supplies and conditional fixed AC/geyser leads are modeled. Manufacturer/site approval, circuits and protective tests remain mandatory.
method: All 29 appliance leads, 3 aquarium cords and 12 media signal cables inspected. Rounded centerline sampled at 96 intervals against actual current base + revision mesh triangles, with a spatial broad phase. This detects crossings, not cable-radius clearance, manufacturer bend radius, structural adequacy, safe working access or electrical compliance. Water-surface crossings are reported separately from solid obstructions; they are expected for immersed aquarium equipment.
design_principles: Provide a socket for each simultaneous appliance and a separate available phone outlet at each bedside.
Keep ordinary leads short, supported and off circulation routes; provide service slack without dangling loops or pinching.
Prefer an accessible dry service zone behind/beside equipment, with designed cable entries rather than invisible routes through wood.
Separate electrical safety from visual tidiness: a hidden cord is not necessarily safe, and a visible cord is not automatically unsafe.
Do not invent a permanent multi-plug/extension solution, circuit ratings, protection or AC/stabilizer decisions.

sources.title: US CPSC: Household Extension Cords Can Cause Fires
sources.use: International safety reference, NOT Indian installation law. Temporary extension use; protect against pinching, overloading and damage.

sources.title: NICREW aquarium heater manufacturer instructions
sources.use: Example manufacturer guidance, not a selected product: offset tank/outlet, drip loop on each lead, disconnect before hands enter water; model-specific heater cooling/submersion instructions.

sources.title: CEA official electrical-safety regulations index
sources.use: Indian legal framework to be applied by a qualified local electrician. This visualization does not inspect circuits, earthing, protective devices, product ratings or site wiring. No legal-compliance certificate.
